about.text: Mongolian öröm: the thick skin of cream that forms on top of boiled milk, usually cow or yak milk. The milk is heated slowly and ladled to aerate it, so the fat rises to form a skin. The pot is left in a cool place for 12–24 hours, then the skin is lifted off in a folded sheet.
